summary.text: Emily Gise is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 90 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Emily Gise was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as public servant.
She took office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Jon Echols, and faces Kymberly Ward, a Democrat, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
